description: This file contains unit tests for the TextFrame-related functionality within the MigraDoc.DocumentObjectModel. It primarily tests the creation and rendering of documents with text frames, including styling and positioning, using the Xunit testing framework.

classes.name: TextFrames
classes.description: Unit test class for testing creation and rendering of text frames within a MigraDoc document.
